revision_reason: Editorial rewrite after QA rejection: direct thesis-led opening and comprehensive PT-BR localization; no material factual, quantitative or causal changes.
qa_fixes_applied: Replaced formulaic metadiscursive EN/PT-BR opening with direct thesis-led analytical prose.
Localized PT-BR technical market and engineering terminology, retaining English only when useful and explaining it on first use.

selection_rationale.relevance: Trading, settlement and information markets increasingly embed economic rules in software and infrastructure rather than treating technology as neutral execution.
selection_rationale.change: Recent evidence connects HFT to financing costs, central banks are moving tokenisation into institutional experiments, and U.S. event-contract markets have expanded sharply enough to trigger new market-design oversight.
selection_rationale.underattention: Discussion is often split between technology coverage and traditional economics, obscuring the question of which theoretical assumptions remain valid when market architecture changes.
selection_rationale.transmission: Market design changes participant incentives and information processing, which can alter liquidity, systemic risk, settlement, financing conditions and institutional responses.

en.title: Markets are becoming programmable — economics is adapting, but the adjustment is uneven
en.deck: Latency, programmable liquidity, tokenised settlement and event contracts are turning market architecture into an economic variable, while the evidence is maturing at different speeds across each mechanism.
en.regime: Market infrastructure is shifting from passive plumbing toward programmable rules that can alter liquidity, information, settlement and financing conditions.
en.key_risk: Calling every technological innovation a paradigm shift can obscure where established economics still explains the mechanism and where genuinely new institutional assumptions are required.

pt-BR.title: Os mercados estão se tornando programáveis — a economia está se adaptando, mas de forma desigual
pt-BR.deck: Latência, liquidez programável, liquidação tokenizada e contratos de eventos estão transformando a arquitetura de mercado em variável econômica, enquanto a evidência amadurece em ritmos diferentes em cada mecanismo.
pt-BR.regime: A infraestrutura de mercado está deixando de ser apenas suporte passivo e passando a incorporar regras programáveis capazes de alterar liquidez, informação, liquidação e condições de financiamento.
pt-BR.key_risk: Tratar toda inovação tecnológica como mudança de paradigma pode esconder onde a teoria econômica existente continua explicando o mecanismo e onde novas hipóteses institucionais são realmente necessárias.
